Shell(node --input-type=module -e  import sharp from "sharp"; import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs"; const svg = readFileSync("public/favicon.svg"); const sizes = [16, 32, 48]; const pngs = []; for (const s of sizes) { const buf = await sharp(svg).resize(s, s).png().toBuffer(); pngs.push({ size: s, buf }); } // Build a genuine ICO container (type 1, PNG entries) const header = Buffer.alloc(6); header.writeUInt16LE(0, 0); // reserved header.writeUInt16LE(1, 2); // type: icon header.writeUInt16LE(pngs.length, 4); // count let offset = 6 + pngs.length * 16; const dirs = []; for (const p of pngs) { const d = Buffer.alloc(16); d.writeUInt8(p.size === 256 ? 0 : p.size, 0); // width d.writeUInt8(p.size === 256 ? 0 : p.size, 1); // height d.writeUInt8(0, 2); // palette d.writeUInt8(0, 3); // reserved d.writeUInt16LE(1, 4); // color planes d.writeUInt16LE(32, 6); // bpp d.writeUInt32LE(p.buf.length, 8); d.writeUInt32LE(offset, 12); offset += p.buf.length; dirs.push(d); } writeFileSync("public/favicon.ico", Buffer.concat([header, ...dirs, ...pngs.map(p => p.buf)])); console.log("wrote favicon.ico", offset, "bytes"); )
